title: Ibm Security Advisories - 2026-10-22
description:
Merged 24 ibm security advisories published on 2026-10-22. Original advisory IDs: IBM-7293249, IBM-7293412, IBM-7284102, IBM-7293143, IBM-7293436, IBM-7293441, IBM-7293440, IBM-7293699, IBM-7293686, IBM-7293494, IBM-7293626, IBM-7293638, IBM-7293628, IBM-7293546, IBM-7293543, IBM-7293539, IBM-7293591, IBM-7293538, IBM-7293531, IBM-7293646, IBM-7293641, IBM-7293580, IBM-7293442, IBM-7293751

Titles:
- Multiple security vulnerabilities in IBM Business Automation Manager Open Editions
- IBM Guardium Data Protection is affected by multiple vulnerabilities
- Security vulnerabilities have been found in IBM Guardium Discover and Classify (IGDC)
- IBM OpenPages for Cloud Pak for Data is Vulnerable to Multiple Spring Framework Vulnerabilities.
- Multiple vulnerabilties in DevOps Test Hub
- Multiple Security Vulnerabilities in Netty affect IBM Sterling B2B Integrator and IBM Sterling File Gateway
- Multiple Security Vulnerabilities in Apache CXF affect IBM Sterling B2B Integrator and IBM Sterling File Gateway
- Protection Mechanism Failure vulnerability affects IBM Sterling B2B Integrator  (CVE-2026-18668)
- IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge is vulnerable to multiple issues in Netty.
- IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge is vulnerable to multiple issues in libxml2
- IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge is vulnerable to multiple issues in Apache Tomcat WebSocket
- IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge is vulnerable to multiple issues in Apache Tomcat-Embed-Core
- IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge is vulnerable to an Uncontrolled Resource Consumption in Apache Tomcat (CVE-2026-66299)
- IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge is vulnerable to Insufficient Technical Documentation and Hex Encoding in Apache Tomcat (CVE-2026-59083, CVE-2026-59084)
- IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge is vulnerable to multiple issues in Netty
- IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge is vulnerable to multiple issues in Apache Tomcat
- IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge is vulnerable to multiple issues in OpenSSH
- IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge is vulnerable to multiple Operator package issues
- IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge is vulnerable to multiple issues in virtualenv
- Multiple vulnerabilities in IBM watsonx Orchestrate with watsonx Assistant Cartridge
- Multiple Vulnerabilities in watsonx.data
- Multiple vulnerabilities in IBM Netcool/OMNIbus Probe for Message Bus
